int.description: Signed arbitrary-precision integer, written `1`. Distinct from `nat`.

nat.description: Natural number, written `1n`. Subtraction of nats yields an `int`, which must be handled.

tez.description: Amount of Tezos currency, written `1tez` or `1mutez`.

address.description: The address type represents a Tezos account address, which can be either an implicit account (tz1, tz2, tz3 prefixed) or a smart contract address (KT1 prefixed). Addresses are used for identifying senders, receivers, and contract targets in on-chain operations.

map.description: Finite map; `big_map` is lazily deserialised for large on-chain storage.

list.description: Immutable singly linked list, built with `::`.

option.description: `Some(x)` or `None()` — CameLIGO has no null; absence is in the type.

unit.description: The single value `()`, returned when there is nothing to return.
